metadata.summary: Beau Greaves took Rob Cross to a last-leg decider before losing out 6-5 on her European Tour debut in the first round of the Hungarian Darts Trophy.
metadata.content: Hungarian Darts Trophy: Beau Greaves just loses out to Rob Cross in last-leg decider on European Tour debut | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to content Hungarian Darts Trophy: Beau Greaves just loses out to Rob Cross in last-leg decider on European Tour debut Beau Greaves became the first woman to play in a PDC European Tour event after qualifying for the Budapest tournament last month; Greaves and Rob Cross both averaged over 100 in first-round match with Cross edging the deciding leg after errors from opponent when left with chance on 70 Friday 28 August 2026 22:25, UK Image: Beau Greaves averaged just shy of 105 on an impressive European Tour debut Beau Greaves took Rob Cross to a last-leg decider before losing out 6-5 on her European Tour debut in the first round of the Hungarian Darts Trophy. Rising star Greaves, 22, made history by becoming the first woman to compete in a PDC European Tour event after qualifying last month for both this weekend's event in Budapest and the Czech Darts Open in September. And she pushed the experienced Cross to a deciding 11th leg in a thrilling tie on Friday evening, averaging an impressive match-best of 104.88. messages.text: 'Box-office' Archer spell stirs 'relentless' England bowling display

metadata.summary: Jofra Archer bowled the fastest opening spell of his Test career as England produced a relentless, high-quality bowling display on day two of the second Test against Pakistan at Lord’s.
metadata.content: Jofra Archer: England's 'box-office' fast bowler touches 94 mph in blistering spell against Pakistan at Lord's | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Jofra Archer: England's 'box-office' fast bowler touches 94 mph in blistering spell against Pakistan at Lord's Mark Wood hails "high quality" England bowling performance as they dismiss Pakistan for 110 on day two of second Test at Lord's; Jofra Archer averages 90.7 mph in fastest opening spell of his Test career; Ollie Robinson is taking wickets at 8.84 a piece this summer Friday 28 August 2026 20:11, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the second day of the second Test between England and Pakistan at Lord’s. Jofra Archer bowled the fastest opening spell of his Test career as England produced a relentless, high-quality bowling display on day two of the second Test against Pakistan at Lord’s. England skittled the visitors for 110 in their first innings , with Ollie Robinson taking 4-11, Archer 3-26 and Josh Tongue 2-27, with Archer having set the tone with a blistering five-over burst before lunch that brought the opening breakthrough. According to CricViz , Archer's opening spell averaged 90.7 mph, with the odd delivery touching 94 mph. He picked up the flat-footed Shan Masood caught behind as Pakistan limped to lunch at 16-2 after 14.1 overs of superb pace bowling. metadata.summary: Moses Itauma pushed Filip Hrgovic off stage before receiving a slap to the face from his opponent at a heated final face-off at the weigh-in ahead of their heavyweight world title fight in London on Saturday.
metadata.content: Moses Itauma vs Filip Hrgovic: Weigh-in turns heated with push and slap after final face off for IBF heavyweight world title fight | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Moses Itauma vs Filip Hrgovic: Weigh-in turns heated with push and slap after final face off for IBF heavyweight world title fight Moses Itauma receives slap to the face after pushing Filip Hrgovic off weigh-in stage following tense final face-off; both fighters weigh in lighter than their previous fights; Itauma, 21, is aiming to become Britain's youngest heavyweight world champion on Saturday at the O2 Arena Friday 28 August 2026 18:08, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Moses Itauma pushed Filip Hrgovic off stage at their weigh-in before the Croatian heavyweight responded by slapping him in the face. Coverage courtesy of DAZN Moses Itauma pushed Filip Hrgovic off stage before receiving a slap to the face from his opponent at a heated final face-off at the weigh-in ahead of their heavyweight world title fight in London on Saturday. After taking to the scales - both fighters weighing in lighter than their previous respective bouts, with Itauma at 241.7lbs and Hrgovic at 236.2lbs - the boxers went face to face and were soon trading barbs. As Hrgovic then moved to the front of the stage to flex for the crowd, Itauma pushed him in the back and the Croatian stumbled forwards and off the podium, keeping his feet. messages.text: Europa League and Conference League draws: British teams learn opponents

metadata.summary: Sunderland will travel to AC Milan in the Europa League and Bournemouth will host the Serie A giants as Brighton and Hearts discovered their Conference League opponents.
metadata.content: Europa League and Conference League draws: Celtic, Bournemouth, Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Brighton, Hearts learn opponents | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Europa League and Conference League draws: Celtic, Bournemouth, Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Brighton, Hearts learn opponents Celtic, Sunderland, Bournemouth and Crystal Palace will compete in the Europa League; Brighton and Hearts are in the Conference League; Europa League league phase begins on September 15 with Conference League on October 15 Friday 28 August 2026 14:11, UK Sunderland will travel to AC Milan in the Europa League and Bournemouth will host the Serie A giants as Brighton and Hearts discovered their Conference League opponents. The league phase draws for both competitions were made on Friday, with Europa League clubs set to play eight matches while Conference League sides will play six, an equal number home and away, between September 2026 and January 2027. Sunderland reached Europe for the first time in 53 years and will travel to the San Siro to face AC Milan, while Bournemouth , in their first-ever European competition, will host the Italian club. Celtic will host Marseille and travel to Marco Silva's Benfica among their eight Europa League matches, while Crystal Palace, last season's Conference League winners, will host LaLiga side Real Sociedad and visit France's Lyon .
